metadata.description: Spec-driven development plugins for Claude Code: spec/plan/implement/verify agents, architecture review, research, and paved-path engineering skills — project-agnostic, no host-repo files required.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec-driven development pipeline: spec-creator turns an idea into an EARS-structured spec, implementation-planner plans it, implement-plan drives implement -> verify -> review, workflow-retro closes the loop.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Read-only researcher agent for evidence-backed fact-finding across the repository, docs, and the web.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: Read-only architecture review agents checking the structural boundaries a repository declares, with evidence-backed findings and REJECT/REVISE/ACCEPT verdicts.

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Paved-path best-practice skills: React, Next.js, Fastify, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, Zod, React Testing Library, security, TypeScript, onion architecture, Mermaid.
